links.title: Invest UP — Official Site
links.note: Main Invest UP site — sector pages, news, and policy index.

detail.whatItGives: Sector overviews, news and events, and links into the broader policy index.
detail.typicalUse: Starting point for external-facing sector information to share with an investor.

links.title: Invest UP — Policies & Government Orders Index
links.note: The master list of every current UP industrial policy and GO — start here if a specific policy isn't yet in this index.

detail.whatItGives: A live, continuously-updated index of all state industrial policies and government orders — the fallback source when a specific policy entry here is missing or outdated.
detail.typicalUse: Checking whether a newer policy or amendment exists that this index hasn't caught up to yet.
quirks: This is a live index page, not a single dated document — that's why it lives here in Invest UP rather than in the sortable Policies table, which expects per-document dates

links.title: Invest UP — Udyami Mitra
links.note: District-level investor facilitation officers — who to contact on the ground.

detail.whatItGives: The Udyami Mitra scheme roster — professionally qualified facilitators assigned per district/region to bridge investors and government departments.
detail.typicalUse: Finding the named facilitation contact for a specific district when an investor needs boots-on-the-ground help.
quirks: Scheme launched 2023 as 'Mukhya Mantri Udyami Mitra' — roster/contacts may turn over; treat named contacts as more perishable than the rest of this index
